title: fix(codex): echo the prompt while the engine writes its transcript
context:
CCC renders a Codex transcript from the rollout file on disk, and measured
on a live app-server that file does not carry the user's own message until
~15s after the turn is accepted. Selecting a freshly spawned session in that
window therefore showed an empty pane -- just a Thinking spinner -- even
though CCC has held the prompt since the moment it was submitted.

Render the known prompt optimistically whenever a session's transcript comes
back empty. The next poll replaces it with the real even
